title: Asymptotically optimal algorithms for random three-dimensional assignment
formal: For independent \(\operatorname{Exp}(1)\) costs \(C_{i,j,k}\), is there a polynomial-time algorithm choosing permutations \(\pi,\sigma\) with \(\sum_i C_{i,\pi(i),\sigma(i)}\le(1+o(1))\operatorname{OPT}\) with high probability as \(n\to\infty\)?
definitions: Definitions and model details remain incomplete. Specify real-input arithmetic and probability conventions, the rate of the error term and the dimensions; finite-precision inputs need a separate justified model.

import_provenance.original_title: Asymptotically optimal algorithms for random three-dimensional assignment
import_provenance.original_statement: For independent Exp(1) costs C_{i,j,k}, find permutations π,σ minimizing Σ_i C_{i,π(i),σ(i)}. Is there a polynomial-time algorithm whose cost is (1+o(1)) times optimum with high probability, extending the strong algorithmic understanding of two-dimensional random assignment?
